rationale: Genome-wide GeCKO knockout screen for genes synthetically lethal with carbonic anhydrase IX (CA9) loss in hypoxic SUM159PT triple-negative breast cancer cells (Chafe et al. 2021). Control (NTC, CAIX-intact) and CA9-knockout (KO-B4) cells were each sampled at T0 and endpoint T11 in duplicate (8 integer-count libraries, guide/gene columns named; 1,000 dummyguide non-targeting controls). The paper's measure is the differential cumulative change between NTC and CA9-KO (loss over time in the KO beyond the NTC). BARCS models that as the genotype x time interaction; a negative interaction term (genotypeCA9KO:timeT11) marks guides depleted in CA9-KO over time more than in NTC, i.e. synthetic-lethal with CA9 loss. The headline hit is the iron-sulfur enzyme NFS1 and the xCT/ferroptosis axis (SLC7A11). 4 residual df.
